svg.title: Japan at a Glance - Infographic
svg.desc: Static SVG infographic presenting key facts, GDP, population, and highlights about Japan in a modern editorial design.

g.text: Stylized map of the Japanese archipelago
The Land of the Rising Sun

text.tspan: Japan is an archipelago of 14,125 islands
in East Asia. The four main islands—
Honshu, Hokkaido, Kyushu and Shikoku—
make up about 97% of its land area.
Capital: Tokyo (population 14 million metro).
Total population: approximately 124 million.
It is a constitutional monarchy with a
parliamentary government.
Japan is famous for its ancient traditions,
Shinto shrines, Zen Buddhism, and its role
as a global leader in technology, robotics,
automotive engineering and pop culture.
Japan is a global economic powerhouse and cultural powerhouse that masterfully balances centuries-old traditions with hyper-modern innovation.
From the neon-lit streets of Tokyo to the serene temples of Kyoto, and from the snow-capped peaks of Hokkaido to the subtropical islands of Okinawa,
the country offers an unparalleled diversity of experiences. It consistently ranks among the safest, cleanest, and most technologically advanced nations in the world.
Japan remains the world’s fourth-largest
economy. After peaking near $5.12 trillion
in 2019, GDP declined due to currency
fluctuations and global economic factors.
Despite recent challenges, Japan continues
to be a leader in high-value manufacturing,
finance, and services. Its economy is
highly export-oriented.

g.text: Source: Japanese Ministry of Internal Affairs & Communications

text.tspan: Vibrant capital with futuristic districts, temples & world-class cuisine.
Ancient capital famous for temples, geisha districts and traditional gardens.
Food capital of Japan with incredible street eats and lively nightlife.
Peace Memorial Park and the famous floating torii gate.
Japan’s iconic mountain and scenic hot-spring resorts.
Stunning nature, wildlife, ski resorts and fresh seafood.

g.text: Data sources: World Bank (GDP), Japanese Ministry of Internal Affairs & Communications (population), Japan National Tourism Organization
All figures are approximate and based on the most recent available public data as of 2024–2025.
